history: 1.0.0: the logo tile with the Neuraldeep.net mark (assets/brand/neuraldeep-mark-2x4.svg) as its default logo. This document is CC0-1.0; the mark is not: it is Copyright Neural Deep Network Ltd, all rights reserved, and its use is limited to the OpenBrick3D demo tiles (parts/assets/brand/NOTICE.md).
1.1.0: presets for the three ways to print the mark (raised, pressed in, two-colour inlay); the geometry for every parameter value is unchanged.

2.0.0: the default artwork is the NEURALDEEP.NET wordmark (assets/brand/neuraldeep-wordmark-2x6.svg, letters from Inter under the SIL Open Font License 1.1) on a 2x6 tile, the smallest tile on which the whole text prints in every relief; the earlier portrait mark is withdrawn. The wordmark is Copyright Neural Deep Network Ltd, all rights reserved (parts/assets/brand/NOTICE.md).

logo.help: Single-colour SVG; lines under 0.8 mm are removed. The default is the NEURALDEEP.NET wordmark drawn for 2x6 (NEURAL / DEEP.NET; the 2x8 file has NEURALDEEP / .NET and the 2x10 file one line), Copyright Neural Deep Network Ltd, all rights reserved: see assets/brand/NOTICE.md

options.label: Logo as its own part (AMS, tool changer)

inlayStyle.help: Swap: the face slab is one part and you change filament after it. Parts: the logo fill is its own part, so each part gets its own filament

reliefHeight.help: Deboss is clamped so 1.8 mm of cavity remains (0.4 mm on plates)
